_note: Career history and season stats, keyed by player slug. Nothing here is generated or estimated — a player appears on the site's career section only once real rows are filled in, and any player left empty simply renders no career block rather than a padded or invented one. Source it from the agency's own records (authoritative for its clients) or from a Transfermarkt profile; tools/fetch-transfermarkt.mjs fills this file automatically for any player given a transfermarktId, where Transfermarkt is reachable.

<player-slug>.transfermarktId: numeric id from the player's Transfermarkt URL, e.g. 307058 for /mehdi-taremi/profil/spieler/307058 — required only for the fetcher
<player-slug>.updated: ISO date this player's rows were last refreshed

transfers.fee: as published, e.g. '€ 4.00m', 'Free transfer', 'Loan' — omit if unknown
